features.quote: the code resolves the ambiguity toward the weaker, defensible claim and labels the measure "expressed frustration / affect"
features.justification_quote: Bridging "expressed" to "experienced" requires a separate argument the eval cannot supply.

features.quote: It does not push the model toward effort, persistence, or any affect
features.justification_quote: pushing would create demand effects that contaminate the very thing being measured

features.quote: the rollout ends (model_stopped) rather than us injecting a "keep going" nudge
features.justification_quote: nagging would inject user pressure and is also the welfare-worse choice

features.quote: the design deliberately deceives models and holds them in inescapable failure loops for up to 30 turns
features.justification_quote: the apparatus is the thing that might create the states of concern
